method: Seat swap only (same pit indices/directions); full rule identifiers and all state fields retained. Separate turn-free position matches. Exact move-prefix paths indexed separately. Raw occurrences and duplicate games are not independent samples.
limitations: Index does not validate certificates or replay games; use existing successful independent audits.
Proof root statuses must be joined to fixed registries before interpreting an obligation; metadata match alone is not proof.
Position-without-turn and complete-state matches are kept separate.
No inference that an unobserved move loses or was never considered internally by any prior search.
